user_story: As a user, I want to assign a category to a task so that I can organize my tasks.

positive.title: Assign a valid category to a task
steps: Choose a valid category from the category dropdown.
Save the changes to the task.
positive.expected_result: The task is successfully updated with the selected category.

negative.title: Attempt to assign a non-existent category to a task
steps: Enter a non-existent category name into the category field.
Save the changes to the task.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the category does not exist.

edge.title: Assign a category to a task with special characters
steps: Choose a category that contains special characters (e.g., #, @, $, %).
Save the changes to the task.
edge.expected_result: The task is successfully updated with the category containing special characters.
